global_rules: A documented crate directory is not an activated Rust crate.
No Cargo.toml or .rs placeholder is created before its implementation gate is satisfied.
Allowed dependencies are maximum boundaries, not dependencies that must be added.
Every implementation begins from exact frozen contracts, profiles, fixtures, and SHA-256 manifests.
Partial, conflicted, truncated, failed, cancelled, candidate, and NotEvaluated states are never reported as complete.
Patch-sensitive WoW facts remain routed through the external wow-addon-engineering-kb.
Repository, addon, owner, path, popularity, and provider names never become hidden production semantics.

crates.name: wow-core
crates.role: shared identities, evidence, provenance, coverage, conflicts, findings, result envelopes, canonicalization, and typed failures

crates.name: wow-store
crates.role: generic SQLite lifecycle, schema registration, immutable ReferenceStore, mutable ProjectStore, objects, publication, snapshots, recovery, retention, and GC

crates.name: wow-reference
crates.role: Reference Profiles, source snapshots, APIDocumentation evaluation, normalized platform facts, corrections, coverage, negative authority, ReferenceStore schema, and exact ReferenceView

crates.name: wow-annotations
crates.role: consumer-neutral annotation semantic model, type lowering, deterministic EmmyLua/LuaLS rendering, source maps, projection loss, parity, and consumer probes

crates.name: wow-emmy
crates.role: pinned upstream Emmy adapter, workspace/session ownership, immutable analyzer snapshots, normalized diagnostics, semantic facts, and source coordinates

crates.name: wow-project
crates.role: materialized source snapshots, project/source universes, TOC/XML/load structure, analyzer and recognizer orchestration, invalidation, project generations, publication bundles, and Blizzard UI source indexing

crates.name: wow-graph
crates.role: versioned graph registries, semantic identities, evidence-bearing assertions, producer partitions, conflicts, immutable graph snapshots, axes, and bounded graph queries

crates.name: wow-recognizers
crates.role: bounded declarative structural recognizer packs over normalized facts, ambiguity, confidence, coverage, producer partitions, evaluation, and graph proposals

crates.name: wow-rules
crates.role: WoW diagnostic providers, exact capability gates, findings, remediation tiers, API-existence and bounded Secret-local rules

crates.name: wow-search
crates.role: exact, migration, lineage, shape, FTS, and graph-assisted retrieval with evidence-preserving deterministic ranking

crates.name: wow-context
crates.role: Project Map, L0/L1 skeletons, progressive evidence-preserving context packs, and context budgets

crates.name: wow-cbm
crates.role: optional Codebase Memory MCP candidate bridge with explicit trust, identity, freshness, and degradation boundaries

crates.name: wow-service
crates.role: transport-independent orchestration, coherent context acquisition, root-cause folding, public use cases, and result envelopes
